title: 1950 AHSME Problem 29
statement: A manufacturer built a machine which will address \(500\) envelopes in \(8\) minutes. He wishes to build another machine so that when both are operating together they will address \(500\) envelopes in \(2\) minutes. The equation used to find how many minutes \(x\) it would require the second machine to address \(500\) envelopes alone is:

solutions.text:
The first machine completes \(\tfrac18\) of a \(500\)-envelope batch per minute, and the second completes \(\tfrac1x\) of a batch per minute. Together they must complete \(\tfrac12\) of a batch per minute. Therefore the required equation is \[ \frac18+\frac1x=\frac12. \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Measure each machine’s rate in batches of \(500\) envelopes per minute
The two individual rates must add to the combined rate
